The first public build of NOIR for Windows.

## Install

Download `NOIR-v1.0.0-windows-x64.zip` below, unpack it anywhere and run `noir.exe`. There is no installer. Your library, playlists and settings are kept in `%APPDATA%\NOIR\NOIR`, so a newer version can simply replace the folder.

Needs Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 11 and most Windows 10 PCs already have. The build isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may ask before the first start: More info, then Run anyway.

## In this build

- YouTube Music home, search, albums, artists, playlists and radio, without an account
- Now Playing with time-synced lyrics, as lines or karaoke
- Playlists and favorites on your PC that hold YouTube Music songs and your own files together
- Your own MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, Opus and WAV files, with tags and covers
- Crossfade between your own files
- Liquid Glass or solid surfaces, dark and light themes, Windows media keys

## Not yet

- Google sign-in, so no sync with your YouTube playlists and likes. This build ships without a Google client.
- Smart and Disco transitions.
- Android, macOS and iOS builds.
